finalists.label: Peeling skin syndrome
finalists.why: It has the most specific and decisive evidence, including 2 heterozygous mutations in exon 2 of the CDSN gene and complete separation of the stratum corneum.

finalists.label: Keratolytic winter erythema
finalists.why: It explains the seasonal variation of symptoms and has no evidence against it.

frontier_selector.why: The presence of 2 heterozygous mutations in exon 2 of the CDSN gene and complete separation of the stratum corneum in the champion provides more decisive evidence than the seasonal variation of symptoms in the runner-up.
